During the talk we shared how we are addressing the growing global challenge of brain recovery through AI-driven VR experiences that simulate everyday activities in engaging, game-based environments. Our platform combines immersive rehabilitation with real-time cognitive biomarker tracking, allowing us to better understand how people recover over time and adapt training to their individual needs. By using Digital Twins, virtual models that reflect a personâs unique cognitive profile, alongside machine learning, we aim to create more personalized and responsive care pathways. We also believe emotional wellbeing is a critical â and often overlooked â part of recovery.
